April 26, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 28.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc sold 8,645 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 22,170 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $861,000, down from 30,815 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $213.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 6.62% or $2.332 during the last trading session, reaching $32.868. About 56.79M shares traded or 110.63% up from the average. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Waldron Lp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 21.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Waldron Lp bought 4,269 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,195 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.09M, up from 19,926 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Waldron Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $838.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.53 during the last trading session, reaching $165.18. About 9.23 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc, which manages about $966.13M and $355.18 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (EMB) by 5,471 shares to 37,595 shares, valued at $4.37M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr by 48,614 shares in the quarter, for a total of 217,316 shares, and has risen its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB).
